subject: Mutual plan — draft owners, gaps, and target timeline (OpenWave POC)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan — draft owners, gaps, and target timeline (OpenWave POC)

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + attached draft MAP so we can lock owners and dates. High-level points: 

- Goal: 6–8 week POC, integrate Redwood inference for feature X and compare latency/cost vs current pipeline
- Primary success criteria: sub-90ms median gen latency, <50% cost delta at expected QPS, pass security checklist

Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_OpenWave_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones + owner columns). Can you confirm the OpenWave owners for the rows below so we can finalize?

Proposed RACI (draft):
- Economic buyer: Daniel Kim (OpenWave) — A
- Security owner: Priya Sharma (OpenWave) — C (we indicated Redwood will provide evidence)
- Legal owner: Sonia Patel (OpenWave) — C
- Eng lead: TBD — suggested: Priya for requirements, Daniel for sign-off

Key milestones (draft):
1) Kickoff & SOW alignment — target: 2026-05-25 — Owner: Alex (Redwood) / Daniel (OpenWave)
2) Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — target: 2026-06-01 — Owner: Priya (OpenWave) / Hiro (Redwood)
3) Initial integration & smoke tests — target: 2026-06-10 — Owner: Grace (Redwood) / OpenWave eng
4) Performance validation & tuning — target: 2026-06-17 — Owner: Grace (Redwood)
5) Exec signoff / go/no-go — target close: 2026-06-24 — Owner: Daniel (OpenWave) / Alex (Redwood)

Dependencies I flagged: procurement timeline, SOC2 evidence review, open ports for VPC peering, and model variant selection.

Next steps for you: please confirm (1) OpenWave owners for Economic/Security/Legal/Eng, (2) whether target close 2026-06-24 is realistic, and (3) any procurement constraints (rules of engagement / PO/contract owner).

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_OpenWave_v1.xlsx; I also included the preliminary SOC2 evidence we typically send.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP once you confirm.

—
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0196

- Confirm Eng lead later today and introduce Alexei.
- Ask Priya to review the SOC2 artifacts and call out gaps.

Sounds good otherwise. Please add a row in the MAP for PO submission and legal review timeline.

Thanks,
Daniel
